gasoline.rule: z<0 (draw vs typical) bullish; z>0 (build vs typical) bearish

distillate.rule: z<0 (draw vs typical) bullish; z>0 (build vs typical) bearish

crude.rule: z<0 (draw vs typical) bullish; z>0 (build vs typical) bearish

modeling_rule: Do not map actual>forecast to direction. Use Surprise = actual − typical week, then z = surprise / historical vol. Inventory z<0 (draw vs typical) is bullish.
